name: compendium-cli
description: Compendium skill toolbox: MyST project scaffolding, building and preview, plus the offline check the compendium doer runs first. The skill is explicit that building a document is not the same as making it reproducible — figure provenance and environment pinning belong to the doer — and that a MyST build exits 0 with unresolved references, so a clean build is never reported without its warnings.
